_why: Served from this folder so the Parser, Form filler and Fill a form work with no internet (venue wifi). Each file is copied byte-for-byte from the npm tarball named here; upgrade by re-packing that exact version and updating the name, version and sha256 together. frontend/vendorOffline.dom.smoke.ts loads the pages with every non-local request aborted.

pdf.worker-3.11.174.min.js.note: the ONE byte-level change: upstream carries 29 raw control bytes (0x00-0x05) inside string literals of its font compiler, which backend/test/sourceControlBytes.test.ts rightly refuses in tracked source; each is written as the equivalent \xNN escape. Checked with the TypeScript parser: same 381,849 syntax nodes, all 11,411 string/template/regex literal values identical.

tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js.note: name fixed by tesseract.js: corePath '/vendor' + this file name, picked when the browser has WASM SIMD

tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js.note: the no-SIMD fallback of the same core

eng.traineddata.gz.note: the LSTM-only data tesseract.js 5 fetches by default; name fixed by langPath '/vendor'

removed: parser.html also loaded pdf-lib 1.17.1, JSZip 3.10.1 and FileSaver 2.0.5 from cdnjs; nothing in frontend/ referenced PDFLib, JSZip or saveAs, so the tags were dropped rather than vendored.
